verdict.rationale: Copilot's cloud/background agents (docs-3, docs-6, docs-8, docs-14, docs-15) let a task be launched and tracked from a centralized web control plane, which supports resuming work from another device or browser, but there's no explicit documentation of continuing an IDE-based chat/agent session started on one device from a different device seamlessly. missing for 10: explicit cross-device session handoff/sync documentation for local IDE sessions, independent hands-on confirmation of resuming a task from another device or browser.
